component.name: Skyloom
component.summary: Read and join conversations on Bluesky

description.p: A native GNOME client for Bluesky with a calm reading and writing experience. Sign in with a dedicated app password, or explore the offline demo without an account.
Skyloom is independent and is not affiliated with Bluesky.
Manage your posts with deletion, private bookmarks and reply and quote controls. Edit your profile and browse followers and following.
Play videos with native controls and upload described MP4 clips. Includes atproto SDK 0.0.74 and improved cache and session safeguards.
